annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3322-18 Standard Specification for Small Unmanned Aircraft System (sUAS) Parachutes
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3322-18 Standard Specification for Small Unmanned Aircraft System (sUAS) Parachutes
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
named_instruments_referenced: WTO TBT Committee Decision on Principles for International Standards
annotation.summary_en: ASTM store page for standard F3322-18. The standard sets design, fabrication and test requirements for deployable parachute recovery systems on small unmanned aircraft. These systems reduce impact energy when a drone fails. Meeting the standard is meant to help applicants get civil aviation authority approval for flights over people.
key_provisions_or_claims: Covers design and manufacture requirements for deployable parachutes on small unmanned aircraft
Defines design, fabrication and test requirements for parachute recovery systems to lessen impact energy on failure
Compliance supports applicants seeking civil aviation authority permission to fly over people
Applicable to sUA seeking approvals such as technical standard orders, flight certificates, waivers or permits
Developed by ASTM Committee F38 under WTO TBT principles
